t: The LAP outdoor LED solar-powered floodlight provides reliable security lighting for domestic outdoor spaces. This wall-mounted floodlight features two adjustable heads, each delivering 500 lumens of bright 5000K daylight illumination, ideal for illuminating garden paths, driveways, and entrances. Its integrated PIR sensor detects movement within a 3-8m range and 120° angle, activating automatically to deter intruders and enhance safety. Constructed from durable ABS plastic with an IP44 rating, this grey floodlight is built to withstand outdoor conditions and offers a long 20,000-hour life, with fixings supplied for straightforward installation.
